people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
translations.bsb: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
translations.kjv: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed
